summary: Source prop sheet for the Software Architect stakeholder in the data-architect-product-trio pack. The sheet arranges architecture-themed tools on a plain white background: a tablet or clipboard with a system diagram, a central cube/module, connected boxes, cloud and database icons, dependency arrows, green data blocks, a rolled blueprint, a dark stylus, and a blue hexagon lanyard badge. The style matches the Issue #56 stakeholder prop language: clean vector-adjacent painterly rendering, isolated readable objects, olive-brown and blue accents, and a calm, technically grounded mood.

composition: Role-specific prop sheet on a clean white or very light background.
The tablet or clipboard is the largest item and anchors the layout.
Supporting papers, cards, a lanyard badge, a notebook or sticky notes, a pen, charts, diagrams, and role tools are arranged around the tablet.
Each object is isolated, readable, and consistent with the stakeholder colour palette.
props: Tablet or clipboard showing a system architecture diagram.
Central cube or module symbol with connected boxes or nodes.
Cloud icon and database cylinder icon.
Arrows indicating dependencies or data flow.
Rolled blueprint held or placed beside the tablet.
Blue lanyard and badge with a hexagonal system/module mark.
style_and_colour: Clean Adventures editorial / vector-adjacent painterly style.
Rounded readable linework and simplified forms.
Olive-brown, navy, cream, and blue diagram accents.
Soft painterly shading and warm lighting.
No real brand logos, realistic UI detail, or tiny pseudo-text.

positive_constraints: Treat this image as the Software Architect prop source for Issue #56 stakeholder assets.
Arrange the tablet/clipboard as the largest prop, with supporting architecture tools around it.
Use the Software Architect palette: olive-brown, navy, cream, blue diagram accents.
Keep props simplified but unmistakably architecture-themed: system diagram, module cube, cloud, database, arrows, blueprint, stylus, hexagon badge.
Maintain the clean white background and isolated, reusable source-asset presentation.
Preserve the calm, approachable, technically grounded mood.
negative_constraints: Do not add generic office clutter or unrelated role props.
Do not overload diagrams with tiny pseudo-text or realistic software UI.
Do not remove the lanyard/badge cue or replace it with a different role's badge icon.
Do not turn the prop sheet into a full scene, environment, or group composition.
Do not introduce other stakeholder colour palettes (purple/gold for data analyst, light blue/green/orange for product manager) as dominant accents.
